"POKÉMON BATTLE ARENA – 2D PIXEL ART FIGHTING GAME

Create a fully playable 2D Pokémon fighting game called POKÉMON BATTLE ARENA, featuring one-on-one battles inspired by classic Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter games, but without graphic violence, blood, gore, or brutal fatalities.

1. VISUAL STYLE – PIXEL ART

- Use detailed retro pixel art graphics.
- Classic 2D side-view fighting game perspective.
- High-quality pixel art character sprites.
- Smooth frame-by-frame pixel animations.
- Retro arcade atmosphere.
- Pixelated backgrounds and environments.
- Colorful special attack effects.
- Consistent pixel art style across all characters, arenas, and menus.
- Use sprite sheets for character animations.

2. COMBAT SYSTEM

- Two Pokémon fight in a one-on-one arena.
- Each player controls one Pokémon.
- Health bars for both fighters.
- Round timer.
- Combo system.
- Light and heavy attacks.
- Blocking, dodging, and counterattacks.
- Unique special abilities with cooldowns.
- Energy meter for powerful ultimate attacks.
- Hit detection and collision mechanics.

3. CONTROLS

- Move forward and backward.
- Jump.
- Crouch.
- Light attack.
- Heavy attack.
- Special attack.
- Block.
- Ultimate ability.

Include keyboard controls for PC and customizable touchscreen controls for Android.

4. PLAYABLE POKÉMON

Include an initial roster of 12 Pokémon:

- Pikachu.
- Charizard.
- Lucario.
- Gengar.
- Blaziken.
- Greninja.
- Garchomp.
- Scizor.
- Machamp.
- Mewtwo.
- Sceptile.
- Gardevoir.

Each Pokémon must have:

- Unique pixel art sprites.
- Individual movement animations.
- Idle animation.
- Walking and running animations.
- Jumping animation.
- Attack animations.
- Blocking animation.
- Hit reaction animation.
- Knockout animation.
- Unique fighting style.
- Three special abilities.
- One ultimate attack.

5. SPECIAL MOVES

Use abilities inspired by each Pokémon's original moves.

Examples:

Pikachu:

- Thunderbolt.
- Quick Attack.
- Thunder.

Charizard:

- Flamethrower.
- Dragon Claw.
- Fire Blast.

Lucario:

- Aura Sphere.
- Power-Up Punch.
- Extreme Speed.

Gengar:

- Shadow Ball.
- Lick.
- Night Shade.

All special attacks must have unique pixel art visual effects and animations.

6. FINISHING SYSTEM

When a Pokémon loses all its health, it should perform a unique knockout animation.

Include:

- Victory poses.
- Defeat animations.
- Victory screen.
- Special victory effects.

Do not include blood, gore, dismemberment, brutal executions, or graphic violence. Keep the combat exciting, competitive, and suitable for all ages.

7. GAME MODES

- Arcade Mode: Fight a series of opponents.
- Versus Mode: Fight against another player.
- Training Mode: Practice moves and combos.
- Tournament Mode: Participate in championships.
- Survival Mode: Fight consecutive opponents.

8. PIXEL ART ARENAS

Create detailed pixel art fighting arenas inspired by Pokémon locations:

- Saffron City.
- Pokémon League.
- Cerulean Cave.
- Volcano Arena.
- Viridian Forest.
- Pokémon Stadium.

Each arena should have animated backgrounds, environmental details, and retro pixel art effects.

9. USER INTERFACE

Create a classic arcade-style interface with:

- Main menu.
- Pokémon selection screen.
- Character portraits.
- Health bars.
- Round timer.
- Energy meters.
- Combo counter.
- Victory and defeat screens.
- Pause menu.

10. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Fully playable game.
- Real-time 2D combat.
- Smooth pixel art animations.
- Character movement physics.
- Hitboxes and hurtboxes.
- Functional combo system.
- AI-controlled opponents.
- Local multiplayer support.
- Android and PC compatibility.
- Touchscreen controls for mobile devices.
- Optimized performance.
- Clean and expandable code architecture.

IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT INSTRUCTIONS

Do not create just a visual prototype or static mockup.

Build a genuinely playable fighting game with functional characters, animated sprites, working attacks, collision detection, combos, enemy AI, health systems, and complete combat mechanics.

The entire game must maintain a consistent retro 2D pixel art aesthetic inspired by classic arcade fighting games.
"
